description: Find occurrences of a symbol within ONE file. Returns: list of line/char positions. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates. Much cheaper than gdscript_references, which reparses every .gd file in the project on Godot 4.6+. Requires Godot 4.7+; reports unsupported otherwise.

file.description: Absolute or relative path to the .gd file

name: gdscript_references_in_file
